result: On the frozen analytic plane, sphere and saddle-like fixtures, extracting only sign-changing cubes with the global fixed-Freudenthal MTet kernel produced the same canonical mesh as traversing every cube on the same lattice. The adjacent-cube seam fixture and exact-zero fail-closed fixture also passed.
claim_boundary: MTet remains a topology/stitching baseline only. No VF11 fidelity advantage is claimed.
